extends.note: Extends the CHM-ISA-1 canonical uop definition with architecture-native instruction encodings. Source ISA bytes remain source-ISA bytes; no flattened Chimera opcode is invented.

policy: Architecture-owned instruction semantics are preserved. A sourced fixed-bit mask is a descriptor, not a backend. Only forms with real round-trip vectors are marked real_backend; all other rows are explicitly not_implemented with a reason. Official conformance counts are copied unchanged from the universal catalog and never upgraded by this derived report.
